title: [VIC] Small Cheeseburger Meal + Extra Cheeseburger for $4 @ McDonald's Doveton
body:
Deal: [VIC] Small Cheeseburger Meal + Extra Cheeseburger for $4 @ McDonald's Doveton

[SuBw00FeR] Nah (profanity) em, go to wendys, make them scared enough to change their whole business.
[TheDukeOfNukem] No interest in Wendy's, but would love McDonald's to be less shit. So I second this.
[DiscountForThee] How many burgers can we get at Wendy's for $4?
[wetsandwich] Honestly, that's a good thing, trust me.
[The1Warden] Out of curiousity, is there a certain deal Wendys was doing that made Maccas do that? like a 4 for 4 as well?
[melbourne guy] I'm assuming it's just the fact Wendy's has now opened across the road!
[The1Warden] I suppose that was the other alternative, that's one way to keep customers.
[jv] @jv Can you decipher this for us?
Albaneseeeee is doing such a great job that on a private industry salary, Maccas is quite expensive now.
[DU99] long way for meal from the western suburbs
[Harrygw] Thinking same. Long one from any where if not local.
[Bullion78] I dropped the kids off in this exact maccas recently. What a shame this deal didn't exist then.
[ElectricMallet] Sounds like you had to settle for a few nuggets.
[Guybrush57] Why didn't you drop your kids off at the pool?
[unity1] How do you order it? App, kiosk or counter?
